lcc_original: 但是永恆主上帝所造的、田野一切的活物惟有蛇最狡猾。蛇對女人說：『園中各樣樹的果子、上帝眞地說過你們都不可喫麼？』
notes: LCC '永恆主' (Eternal Lord) renders UNV '耶和華' (YHWH/H3068); '上帝' renders UNV '神' (Elohim/H430) — LCC uses these consistently throughout
First sentence word order differs: LCC topicalizes '田野一切的活物' before '惟有蛇', while UNV places them after. SNs distributed to matching words regardless of reordering
LCC '眞地' (truly) condenses UNV '豈是(H637)真(H3588)' — both H637 (אַף, indeed/also) and H3588 (כִּי, that/for) are attached to '眞地' as a combined emphasis unit
LCC '各樣' (every kind) corresponds semantically to UNV '所有' (H4480+H3605 = מִכֹּל, from all); the WAH-prefixed pair is retained
LCC '說過' (has said) corresponds to UNV '說' with morph 8804 (qal perfect); the '過' is a Chinese perfective aspect particle with no separate SN
LCC opening '但是' (but/however) is a Chinese connective with no Hebrew SN equivalent — left unannotated
Second mention of '蛇' in second sentence is untagged, following UNV convention where H5175 is not re-applied to the subject in the continuation clause
LCC '喫' is an orthographic variant of UNV '吃' (both = eat, H398)
